name: Geometric PCSA
notes: Parallel contractile area before an explicit fibre-angle projection. Inputs must be unit-compatible and provenance-linked. Do not overwrite source-native published PCSA values.

name: Effective PCSA
notes: Tendon/line-of-action projected area under the conventional cosine treatment. Kept versioned because PCSA/pennation conventions vary across the literature.

name: Relative structural force-capacity index
notes: Specific tension cancels if a common value would otherwise be assumed. This is a structural index, not exercise strength or exact Newton force.

name: Volume two-thirds fallback
notes: Use only when architecture is unavailable and geometric similarity is an explicit approximation. Never treat as the primary cross-muscle force model.
